t: This is London House, a hall of residence in the London Borough of Camden. It was designed by Herbert Baker, an English architect who was the most prominent and prolific of his generation. He is remembered as the dominant force in South African architecture, where he developed a neo-classical style that interacted theatrically with the landscape and projected imperial strength and permanence. If you look at the building with that in mind, you are seeing the work of an architect whose reputation was built on a sense of solidity and scale.
